items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03
items.q: Holkamp was basically merely a booking agent.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's something I knew nothing about. Uh, I never thought of it being a franchise operation in that period, really. Oh, yes. That's right.

There were probably eight or ten Holkamp shows, and they were advertised and promoted, you know, through the channels through which carnivals are promoted. Uh-huh. Holkamp was basically merely a booking agent.
